description: Schéma directeur des Infrastructures de recharges pour véhicules électriques de l'Eurométropole de Strasbourg is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données suit le schéma national Schéma directeur des Infrastructures de recharges pour véhicules électriques. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are recharge, vehicule, electrique, vehicule electrique, moissonnage, IRVE. The portal shows 148 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
